```bash
curl -X POST \
     -H "x-apikey: ABC321" \
     -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
     -d '{"type":"comment","attributes":{"text":"Confirmed #malware"}}' \
     https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/192.168.1.1/comments
```

Or, if you prefer Python:

```python
import requests

url = "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/192.168.1.1/comments"
headers = {
    "x-apikey": "ABC321",
    "Content-Type": "application/json"
}
payload = {
    "type": "comment",
    "attributes": {
        "text": "Confirmed #malware"
    }
}

response = requests.post(url, headers=headers, json=payload)
print(response.status_code)
print(response.json())
```

Make sure your API key has the necessary permissions (the “Comment” scope). If you run into any errors, let me know what the response says and I’ll help troubleshoot!
